name: gohighlevel
description: Connect Claude to your GoHighLevel sub-account: contacts, lead sorting, SMS/email, pipelines, CSV imports, and sales reports.
long_description:
Gives Claude full access to one GoHighLevel sub-account through the official API v2 using a Private Integration Token.

**What Claude can do**
- Search, create, update and tag contacts; notes, tasks, workflow enrollment
- Score and sort leads, round-robin assignment, find duplicates
- Send single or bulk SMS and email with merge fields (DND always respected)
- Manage pipelines: create deals, move stages in bulk, mark won/lost
- Import CSVs with automatic column mapping and dedupe; export contacts
- Pipeline, call, activity and revenue reports; call transcripts and recordings

**Safety:** anything that sends messages, changes many records, or deletes first shows a preview and only runs after you approve it.

**Setup:** in GoHighLevel open your sub-account → Settings → Private Integrations → Create, grant the scopes listed in the README, then paste the token and your Location ID here.

api_key.title: Private Integration Token
api_key.description: From GoHighLevel: your sub-account → Settings → Private Integrations → Create new integration. Starts with "pit-". Stored securely in your system keychain.

location_id.title: Location ID
location_id.description: Your sub-account's Location ID: Settings → Business Profile, or the ID in your GHL URL after /location/.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Turn on to let Claude look and report only — no sending, editing, or deleting.

confirm_threshold.title: Ask for approval when an action affects at least this many records
confirm_threshold.description: 1 = always show a preview and ask before sending or changing anything (recommended). Higher numbers let small actions run immediately.

country_code.title: Default phone country code
country_code.description: Added to phone numbers without a + sign (used by imports and duplicate checks). 1 = US/Canada.
